wallpapers.title: A prime 'reef' estate
wallpapers.caption: False clownfish off Cabilao Island, Bohol, Philippines
wallpapers.desc: Location matters. Just ask the false clownfish seen in the image at Lighthouse Reef, near Cabilao Island, Philippines. In these tropical waters packed with hungry mouths and fierce competition, they've secured prime real estate: a sea anemone armed with thousands of microscopic stinging cells.
